protocol.description: Network protocol to use: tcp, udp, udplite, dccp, sctp, or tipc.

host.description: Target host IP or hostname. Required for transmit mode.

rtt_options.description: Round trip probe options in format Nn,Nd,Nm,Nf. Nn=iterations, Nd=payload size, Nm=deviation filter, Nf=force average ms (empty=perform probes).

memadvise.description: Memory advice for mmap: normal, sequential, random, willneed, dontneed, noreuse.

transmit_method.description: Transmit function: sendfile, mmap, splice, or rw.

sched_policy.description: Scheduling policy: sched_rr, sched_fifo, sched_batch, or sched_other. Empty uses default.

setsockopt_options.description: List of setsockopt options to apply. Each item is an object with level (number), optname (string), and optval (number/string). Use 'netsend -s list' to see available optnames.

command.description: Command or file path to transmit, or help topic.

tipc_socket_type.description: Tipc socket type (SOCK_STREAM, SOCK_DGRAM, etc.). Required if protocol is tipc.

cipher_key.description: MD5 signature key for peer authentication.
